crossRefs.note: “ ‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma…

translations.web: “ ‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to Yahweh.
translations.bsb: Everyone who is native-born shall prepare these things in this way when he presents a food offering as a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
translations.kjv: All that are born of the country shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savour unto the LORD.
translations.asv: All that are home-born shall do these things after this manner, in offering an offering made by fire, of a sweet savor unto Jehovah.
